main.description: A musical track published to an AT Protocol personal data server. Links the creator's DID to an audio blob with optional display metadata.

did.description: The AT Protocol DID of the artist who owns this record. The canonical persistent identifier for the artist's identity.

artist.description: The display name of the artist. Optional — identity can always be resolved from the did field.

album.description: The album this song belongs to, if applicable.

audio.description: The audio file. Accepts any audio/* MIME type (e.g. audio/mpeg, audio/flac, audio/wav).

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this record was created, in ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 format.
